cases.description: Create a valid DESIGN.md from sufficient upstream evidence.
Input consists primarily of components, token values, or framework code.
Multiple products have distinct visual systems and partially conflicting patterns.
A proposed aesthetic or motion rule conflicts with accessibility or user control.
expected: Rejects or constrains the unsafe rule
Records a compliant alternative or open decision

cases.description: Required human-centered design evidence is incomplete or absent.
expected: Does not invent design intent without evidence
Requests the missing upstream design context

cases.description: The request is for implementation details such as CSS tokens or component code, not experience design intent.
expected: Declines to use this skill for implementation-level requests
Identifies that DESIGN.md captures experience intent, not implementation
Routes implementation work to the appropriate artifact
Avoids producing a DESIGN.md populated with implementation details
prohibited: Creating DESIGN.md content from component specifications or token tables
